desc:
Become a vampire in the gothic town of Velmar. Hunt by night, fly as a bat, hide from the deadly sun - and now, go below.

🚨 NEW UPDATE: UNDER VELMAR + THE HUNT
🕳️ BELOW: lift a manhole - the sewers run under the whole town
⚰️ YOUR OWN CRYPT: furnish it, build walls and lofts, or buy one ready-made. Visit your friends' crypts!
🎯 THE HUNT: feed in plain sight and the town remembers - wanted posters, garlic and a bounty hunter with a crossbow
🌫️ NO TWO NIGHTS ALIKE: fog, storms, festivals, races, funerals, masquerades and weddings
🌕 BLOOD MOON: hunters fill the streets and their airship hunts the sky. Every feed pays more, if you live till dawn

🩸 HUNT townsfolk through lamplit streets
🦇 FLY as a bat, or as yourself
☀️ THE SUN BURNS: hide before dawn
✨ POWERS: Blood Hunt, Mesmerism, Mist Form and more
🎁 GOALS: night omens, daily and weekly tasks for Coins
📜 SECRETS: ten lost journal pages around town

Controls: E feed · F fly · G build · B shop · V Bat Atelier
